# One set of books for every marketplace you sell on.

> Free private tool for resellers: drop your eBay, Etsy, Poshmark, Mercari, Depop, Whatnot and Shopify reports and get one monthly profit and loss, what each channel really keeps, and a Schedule C style worksheet. Add a mileage log CSV and sourcing and post office trips go on Schedule C line 9 at the IRS standard mileage rate for each trip's date (72.5 cents to June 30 2026, 76 cents from July 1 2026). Add your inventory log (sourcing sheet CSV: item or SKU, quantity, cost, date bought) and it fills in Schedule C Part III for the year: opening inventory (line 35), purchases (36), closing inventory (41) and cost of goods sold (42), matching each sold unit to the oldest purchase on hand. Depop's Download sales file (three months a file) is read too: item price plus buyer shipping as sales, the label, Depop fee, Depop Payments fee and boosting as deductions, refunds as returns, buyer-paid sales tax and the Buyer Marketplace Fee kept out of sales, and a sale repeated across overlapping downloads counted once. Nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
